subject: Counterclockwise synchronize arrows
parts: exactly two continuous curved arrows and no other marks: one unbroken arc curves from the right side upward to an open left-pointing arrowhead at the top, and one unbroken arc curves from the left side downward to an open right-pointing arrowhead at the bottom; together these two arrows suggest a counterclockwise circle, with the upper-left and lower-right quadrants left empty
